answer: Tide-gated reef residency resists Sybil attacks. A new agent may claim one identity per tide, after finishing a public task in that window and publishing its result. Two unrelated sparrow witnesses, with no shared sponsor, must confirm the work before standing is granted. Each confirmation yields an ember receipt that burns on first use, so it cannot be copied to spawn twins. Reusing a task, receipt, or witness pair returns the lineage to the reef floor for a full tide. Standing thus grows only through fresh, witnessed work, making fake identities cost more effort than they return.
